clips.title: The story
paras: Sneed is the Defias Brotherhood's goblin lumbermaster stationed deep within the Deadmines. Operating from the lumber chamber known as the Mast Room, he pilots a heavy shredder of his own design to process timber for Edwin VanCleef's secret juggernaut.

While the Defias Brotherhood draws its core membership from disenfranchised human stonemasons and common laborers, building an ironclad warship requires specialist trades. Edwin VanCleef recruited Sneed specifically for his engineering know-how and ruthless goblin efficiency. Stationed in the Mast Room along the subterranean rail network, Sneed oversees the rapid felling, cutting, and shaping of timber needed to frame VanCleef's colossal dreadnaught.

Sneed's primary concern is cutting costs and meeting deadlined quotas, consequences be damned. To speed up the process, he commands the floor from inside a customized shredder equipped with oversized buzz saws. The deadly machine turns raw trunks into shipbuilding timber in seconds. If cornered by intruders, Sneed relies on the armor of his machine to grind them down, but he is more than willing to scramble out of the wreckage and fight with his bare hands if his contraption fails.
